propositions: A single criterion's evidence run exhaustion (LLMBudgetExhaustedError) propagates uncaught, aborting bounded recovery and discarding all gathered evidence instead of preserving it as partial input to the finalizer

Per-criterion evidence loops must catch budget/runaway/token exhaustion errors and substitute content-free exhausted placeholders, allowing the finalizer to render partial verdicts and marking unverifiable criteria

Recovery must fail outright only when EVERY criterion's evidence run fails, raising CompletionRecoveryError with diagnostic counts; single-criterion exhaustion is a per-criterion safeguard, not fatal to aggregate
Exhausted placeholder entries must state that evidence could not be gathered within bounds and never be presentable as affirmative, so the finalizer scores the criterion unmet/indeterminate
